newsitem.title: USA: Armstrong buys $15 mln of Dal-Tile stock.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong buys $15 mln of Dal-Tile stock.

text.p: Armstrong World Industries Inc said Monday it had fulfilled its obligation to buy $15 million of Dal-Tile International Inc shares.
Armstrong bought 37 percent of Dal-Tile's outstanding shares in December 1995, when Armstrong's American Olean Tile Co subsidiary combined with Dal-Tile.

To mitigate the dilution of its stake after Dal-Tile's initial public offering in August 1996, Armstrong acquired $10 million of Dal-Tile stock at that time. It said it had bought another $15 million of the stock on the open market.
Armstrong said it has no plans to buy any more Dal-Tile shares. Its stake in Dal-Tile is now about 34.4 percent.
Armstrong shares were up 7/8 to 64-3/4 at midday Monday. Dal-Tile was up 1/4 to 14-3/4.
